basic_details.job_title: Tiruvannamalai District Health Society Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 60 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: GNM/B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved private nursing college recognised by the Indian Nursing Council, with valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.
qualification.details: Qualification: GNM/B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved private nursing college recognised by the Indian Nursing Council; Valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council Age limit: Maximum 50 years

how_to_apply: Use the model application form for the contract/temporary Staff Nurse post given in the annexure to the notice.
Enclose copies of certificates: educational qualification, mark certificate, caste certificate and residence certificate.

Application must reach by 04.12.2026, 5.00 PM; later applications will not be accepted.

faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.
